annotations.title: Add a record through a view's own form

description: Creates one record in Development through a view's own "add" form — the SAME record-create door the dashboard's Records room uses, curated to the view's declared add.fields: data may name only those fields. A file or image field takes the reference an upload already returned (file:<uuid>) — never a new upload path. showFrom/showUntil set the record's own publish window, only when the view also declares "window": true. Refused if the view declares no "add" form. Development only — Live add goes through the dashboard; this tool doesn't reach Live yet. On the founder's Logs.

showFrom.description: ISO 8601 — only when the view declares "window": true
